🎯 Opus Focus

Name:

Watch closely. Count every move. No counter — your focus is the game.

Score: 0  •  Streak: 0  •  Rounds: 0
Score: level×10 per correct count + fast-answer bonus (up to 30, −2/sec). Your session score saves to the Top 10 when you go back to the menu.

1. Pick who to watch (Levels 1–3 only)

2. Pick a level

Levels 4–5 use two or three characters at once — no need to pick one. Sometimes one flips, sometimes two, sometimes all. Count every flip.

3. Pace

Paces run slow to fast, left to right. Single-character levels (1–3) offer Fast and Faster. Duo/Trio (4–5) offer Steady and Fast, since there's more to track.

Counts are random every round, so you can never just guess last time's number.

Get ready…
Count every jump. Don't look away!
